phase2-01-cute-low-poly-fox-sitting-down.note: A clean, charming faceted fox that matches the picture and holds up from every side, including the back and the tail wrapped around it.

phase2-02-red-high-top-sneaker.note: A convincing canvas high-top with real-looking laces and eyelets; only a faint streak on the heel, and the red leans slightly raspberry.

phase2-03-gaming-chair-black-and-purple.note: A complete black gaming chair with purple side stripes, armrests and a five-star base; the backrest insert is only slightly speckled.

phase2-04-retro-arcade-machine.note: The red cabinet is clean from the front and sides, but the back panel is a dark, smeared copy of the front with red streaks.

phase2-05-sci-fi-laser-pistol-white.note: A crisp white-and-orange pistol matching the picture, but the white body looks grubby with scuffs, and gold is smeared around the muzzle.

phase2-06-wooden-shield-with-a-lion.note: The wooden shield is clean, but the lion is a smeared, scribbly sketch with a creepy grin, and it's repeated on the back.

phase2-07-chibi-knight-with-a-big-helmet.note: A cute, clean chibi knight with a big visored helmet and flowing red cape, complete and tidy from every angle.

phase2-08-vintage-film-camera.note: The front is a convincing vintage camera, but the back is warped, with a dark smear and a see-through hole. Close to not usable.

phase2-09-donut-with-pink-frosting.note: A clean, appetizing frosted donut with red and white sprinkles, consistent all around; the frosting leans coral rather than baby pink.

phase2-10-astronaut-helmet.note: A clean, classic white astronaut helmet with black visor and red neck ring, complete from every angle; only faint scuffs.

phase2-11-stack-of-old-books-with-a-cand.note: No final: it ran out of GPU memory (a bug to fix, not a quality verdict). The preview was made and is shown.

phase2-12-skateboard-with-graffiti-art.note: A recognizable skateboard with wheels and trucks, but the graffiti lettering smeared into illegible blotches and the deck is pinched like a peanut.

phase2-13-cute-cartoon-car-bright-blue.note: A clean, charming blue cartoon car that holds up from every angle, with opaque white windows and only faint speckles on the roof.

phase2-14-bubble-tea-with-tapioca-pearls.note: The cup came out almost solid black on every side, with no milk-tea color or visible pearls, so it reads as cola.

phase2-15-health-potion-in-a-round-glass.note: The round orange potion bottle is the right shape, but blocky square patches cover its upper body, with a dark smudge near the base.

phase2-16-green-dragon-sitting-cartoon.note: A recognizable sitting cartoon dragon, but the skin is dark and blotchy and a detached tail fin floats beside the body.

phase2-17-bowl-of-ramen-with-an-egg.note: Convincing ramen with egg, scallions, meat and both chopsticks, complete from every side; only faint orange hairlines mark the white bowl.

phase2-18-electric-guitar.note: The body is warped into a curled, bloated shell and the fretboard is grey noise, though it reads as a guitar from the front.

phase2-19-small-cabin-in-a-snowy-forest.note: A clean, complete snow-roofed cabin with doors, windows, deck and steps from every side; the forest was dropped, leaving just the cabin.

phase2-20-hot-air-balloon.note: A clean cream hot air balloon with skirt, basket and cables, consistent from every side; only faint blotchy shading on the envelope.
